learning_outcomes.text: Identify the elements and equipment of welding processes and other joining techniques
Be able to explain the physical fundamentals of welding processes and other joining techniques
Classify welding processes and other joining techniques
Know the fundamentals, elements and equipment of welding or other joining processes
Know the regulations and standards related to welding processes and other joining techniques

syllabus_topics: Fusion welding processes for metallic materials.
Thermal cycle in the welding process.
Defectology of welded joints. Detection by industrial radiography.
Regulations and standards related to welding processes and other joining technologies.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is based on continuous assessment. Written Test 1 (45%), Written Test 2 (40%), Lab Practices (10%), and Seminars (5%) contribute to the final grade. A minimum grade of 5.0 out of 10.0 is required for each written test and for lab practices. Students must pass both the written tests and the lab practices components to pass the course. If a student fails one component in the ordinary call, they must retake only that failed component in the extraordinary call. Lab practices require 100% attendance and cannot be re-evaluated for attendance, but the evaluation of practical work (report/exam) can be re-evaluated.
